security_justification.audit_integrity: The ordering gate keeps every check it makes today; it stops misreading an assessment's own source as implementation, so a correctly ordered generated assessment can be recorded and verified rather than left unrecorded.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication, authorization, branch protection or required-check setting changes; only one path's classification in the governance policy moves.
security_justification.authority_provenance: Ordering is still proven from Git ancestry. The recorded commits are still taken as given, which #943 tracks; this change neither widens nor narrows that trust.
security_justification.concurrency: The checker is a single-process read of Git history and the policy; nothing concurrent is added or changed.
security_justification.confidentiality: No data leaves the repository; the test builds a disposable local repository from the live governance artifacts and removes it afterwards.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic primitive, signature, signed record or hash binding is added, removed or changed; the activation record binds blobs at its own technical commit, not at this policy revision.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Diagnostics keep their fixed identifiers and messages; the test asserts the existing assessment-shares-implementation-commit identifier.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No CI job, external service or integration changes; the design-pattern-governance job runs the same checker on the new policy.
security_justification.fail_posture: The gate still fails closed on missing history and on a recorded assessment commit that carries implementation. One path, the generator's input, no longer counts as implementation, exactly as assessment.json never has.
security_justification.lifecycle: The proposal, implementation and archive lifecycle and the assessment and final phases are unchanged; the change lands as three pull requests with no fold.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Edits are confined to the policy's planning pattern list and note, one new test file and this change's directory; the association check still requires an owner for every other governed path.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No privacy transform or field policy is touched; the change concerns repository path classification only.
security_justification.resource_retention: Nothing is retained; the test's disposable repositories are deleted after the run.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry, redelivery or replay behaviour exists or changes in the governance checker.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The assessment source is generator input; wherever an assessment.json sits beside it the drift rule binds the two byte for byte, and a source with no assessment beside it is never read by the gate. Treating it as planning matches its role, and no executable or runtime path enters the exempt set.
